newsitem.title: UK: Scotland's McQueen buys Rand McNally unit.
newsitem.headline: Scotland's McQueen buys Rand McNally unit.

text.p: Scottish information technology and communications company McQueen Ltd said on Tuesday that it had acquired the U.S.-based Rand McNally Media Services group.
The joint company, which would continue to do business under its original name, would have an annual turnover of 100 million stg.
Rand McNally, the parent company of the U.S. firm would hold a minority stake in McQueen.
McQueen, based in Galashiels, Scotland provides technical support services to the information technology and communications firms operating in Europe.
The company's clients include Motorala, Microsoft and Hewlett-Packard. The company declined to reveal the value of the consideration.
McQueen said it would take on all 350 employees of Rand McNally Media Services bringing its total workforce to 1,000.
